messages:
liz chan: Quick heads-up: Carmine Health wants a short POC next month. They want us to validate their custom-quant-13b-v2 and our redwood-chat-13b baseline. Main asks: p95 latency <=220ms for 512-token responses, BAA/KMS posture, and a monthly commited quote for 80 req/s sustained.

omar: Added infra notes. Dedicated looks OK but custom-quant-13b-v2 may need custom kernels. Ask customer whether the weights are standard int8/4bit layout or something bespoke. Also need sample prompt distribution.

priya r: Security checklist: BAA required, KMS for envelope keys, private control plane with S3 VPC endpoints, and retention policy for logs. They asked about SSO (SAML) and SCIM for enterprise user sync 95 we can support both.

sam k: Perf note: On A10x4 a tuned 13B quant typically hits p95 ~160-200ms for single-request non-batched 512 tokens. But custom quant variance is large. Recommend we run a compile + bench with their artifact.

liz chan: They also want to know if we can do per-customer isolation (no co-tenancy) for model serving during POC.

omar: Yes, single-tenant Dedicated or per-customer nodepool with strict VPC rules. That will bump cost. I'll estimate node count after bench.

liz chan: Pricing ask: rough committed monthly number for 80 req/s, avg 512 tokens. Sales needs a sticky number to show the VP tomorrow.

sam k: Quick sketch: 80 rps * 512 tokens = 40,960 tokens/sec -> *86,400 = 3.54B tokens/day -> ~106B tokens/month. Hosted pricing would be high. For Dedicated, convert to GPU-hours: assume 8x A10 pool for sustained throughput with headroom. I'll produce a GPU-hour based estimate by EOD.

deploy-bot: [job queued] compile-bench job_id=cb-73001-01 nodepool=dedicated-a10x4

priya r: Also flagging legal: if PHI is present we need the BAA signed before any production data. For POC we can accept sanitized subset but we need the questionnaire answered. I'll DM the customer security checklist.

omer: Small thing: tokenizers. The customer uses a custom tokenizer for clinical notes with weird unicode. We need them to include tokenizer files and a small script showing detokenization. Otherwise tokenization mismatch will kill latency numbers.

liz chan: Action items:
- sam k: run compile + bench and share p50/p95 and GPU utilization (ETA 10h)
- omar: nodepool sizing + rough commit pricing (ETA 1 business day)
- priya r: send security checklist + BAA template, confirm SSO needs (ETA EOD)
- liz chan: request model artifact upload link + ~1k representative prompts (ETA today)

sam k: Bench started. Will publish results in thread. If compile fails we'll fallback to float16 variant or run our redwood-chat-13b until they ship compatible weights.

deploy-bot: [job update] cb-73001-01 status=running eta~25m

priya r: Also ask them whether they require audit logs forwarded to their SIEM vs. monthly report. That affects retention and costs.

customer snippet (sanitized): "We can provide weights on a private S3 with VPC endpoint and a sample set of clinical prompts. Some PHI may remain; if so we prefer on-prem ingestion. Can you confirm your on-prem timeline?"

liz chan: Reply: S3 via VPC endpoint is preferred and fastest. On-prem ingestion adds ~1-2 weeks and requires extra legal. We'll offer both but note timeline impact.

omar: If they opt for on-prem model dropbox, we'll need SSH key exchange and a signed data transfer agreement. Budget ~2 extra engineering days.

sam k: Bench results: p50=130ms p95=210ms on dedicated-a10x4 with redwood-chat-13b baseline for 512 tokens (single-request). Custom-quant-13b-v2 initial compile failed on one kernel; resolving with runtime team now.

priya r: Good to know. If compile fixes take >48h, request a scoped POC using only sanitized prompts and our baseline while kernel work happens.

liz chan: Scheduling customer sync Thursday 09:30 PT. Please join with your artifacts. Any blockers?

sam k: Only blocker is the kernel compile fix; I'll keep you posted.

priya r: I'll need the security contact and clarification on PHI scope before the call.

liz chan: Thanks everyone. I'll post the S3 link when customer uploads and capture the BAA thread.
